name: inertial-rebound-scroll
title: Inertial Rebound Scroll
description: A scroll container featuring physical overscroll rubberbanding that snaps back to boundaries via damped spring physics.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Overscroll Rubberband Drag: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
